model: weighted score = 1 * +Healing + 1 * Spell Power + 0.5 * Intellect + 0.5 * Spirit + 2 * MP5
note: A DESIGN CHOICE of BattleInfoTool, not an empirical WoW result: ForeverSim does not simulate healing, so no measured stat weights exist for a healer. These coefficients were chosen by hand as a transparent starting approximation and are marked (approx.) in the tooltip. Assumptions documented so the choice can be judged: (1) a point of Spell Power (ITEM_MOD_SPELL_POWER_SHORT) is assumed to be the same bonus as a point of +Healing (ITEM_MOD_SPELL_HEALING_DONE_SHORT), and an item the client reports with both keys is counted through both - if the client ever gives both keys for one bonus, the score counts it twice (the +N Spell Damage and Healing line is assumed to come only under the Healing key here, its Spell Damage key is damage-only and never counted); (2) Intellect and Spirit are worth half a healing point; (3) MP5 (ITEM_MOD_MANA_REGENERATION_SHORT) is worth two healing points; (4) crit, haste, spell ranks, talents, procs, overheal and cast uptime are NOT modelled. The percentage shown is the change in this score against the equipped item - an approximate healer ITEM score, not an actual healing increase. Generated into Weights.lua by tools/make_weights.py.
